name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage that triggers compaction when DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT is not 1, compactAtTokens is 0, or context.tokens is unavailable.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Strictly below this actual character reduction, retain history and pins and immediately force written HANDOFF NOW, regardless of launcher flag or token count. Equality passes. Never requests a built-in summary.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

injectedMinChars.title: Injected text threshold
injectedMinChars.description: Harness-shaped text at least this long is scored using structural recognition; 0 disables it. Untagged user text and fenced examples are preserved.

replyMinChars.title: Long reply threshold
replyMinChars.description: Old assistant replies at least this long may be abridged to their opening and closing; 0 disables it.

maxPostCompactTokens.title: Visible post-cut token warning
maxPostCompactTokens.description: Report visible conversation size against this warning threshold; never triggers summary; excludes system/tool prefix; 0 disables the warning.

compactAtTokens.title: Compaction token trigger
compactAtTokens.description: With DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT=1 and readable context.tokens, turn.complete requests a prune at this count. Above 0 replaces the percentage trigger; otherwise use compactAtPercent.

targetVisibleTokens.title: Post-cut visible token target
targetVisibleTokens.description: With DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT=1 only, tighten the cut over cached Jev answers toward this visible-message estimate. Excludes system/tool prefix; 0 disables. The reduction floor still applies.

handoffAt.title: Handoff order size
handoffAt.description: With DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT=1, visible tokens at which HANDOFF SOON is ordered, again per 50000 tokens of growth. Ratio-forced NOW does not wait for this threshold.

handoffForceAt.title: Forced handoff size
handoffForceAt.description: With DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT=1, visible tokens at which HANDOFF NOW is ordered; raised to handoffAt if lower. A reduction-ratio miss forces NOW regardless of flag or token count.

handoffDir.title: Handoff directory
handoffDir.description: Session-id folders hold latest.md, resumed.json, prune_skipped.json and order.json. Relative paths use the cwd captured on the session's first compaction or turn-complete callback; later cwd changes do not move them. Absolute paths share a root.

handoffSkillPath.title: Handoff skill path
handoffSkillPath.description: Path cited in handoff orders; relative paths use the same captured session cwd as handoffDir.

idleWarmMinutes.title: Idle cache warm interval (minutes)
idleWarmMinutes.description: 0 = off. Otherwise, this many minutes after each turn ends, send one minimal model fork over the session's own transcript so the prompt cache is read and its TTL reset. Use a value under the cache lifetime (for example 50 for the 1 hour cache). Never submits a prompt.

idleWarmMax.title: Idle warms per gap
idleWarmMax.description: At most this many warms per idle gap, so an abandoned session stops spending. A new prompt starts a new gap.

logDecisions.title: Log per-item decisions
logDecisions.description: Opt-in diagnostics include kept and dropped call probabilities and text decisions. The outcome line is always logged.
